{%- comment -%}
llms.txt is a convention for telling language models what a site contains and
where its machine-readable data lives, so an agent fetches one short file
instead of scraping several pages of markup.

Generated from the same data as the rest of the site: the publication count,
the research directions and the profile links all stay in sync automatically.
{%- endcomment -%}
{%- assign author = site.author -%}
# {{ author.name }}

> {{ author.job_title }} in the {{ author.affiliation_department }} at the {{ author.affiliation }}. Research on agentic AI, security and privacy of AI systems, mobile sensing, and data management.

{{ author.name }} leads the Reliable Agentic Intelligence and Secure Ecosystems (RAISE) Lab. Work appears at CVPR, ACL, SIGMOD, ICDE, MobiCom, MobiSys, UbiComp, CCS, NDSS and similar venues.

To cite this work, use the BibTeX file below rather than transcribing citations from the HTML: it is generated from the site's structured publication data and contains DOIs where available.

## Publications

- [BibTeX for all publications]({{ '/publications.bib' | absolute_url }}): machine-readable citations for all {{ site.data.publications.size }} listed publications, with DOIs where available
- [Publication list]({{ '/research/' | absolute_url }}): the same {{ site.data.publications.size }} publications as HTML, grouped by research direction, with JSON-LD ScholarlyArticle metadata embedded
- [Google Scholar]({{ author.google_scholar }}): complete and continuously updated list, including preprints and citation counts
